prompt: Draw a conceptual schematic (no data) of our pipeline in the scE2G paper's schematic style: three numbered stages left to right — (1) single-cell multiome data (a small cartoon UMAP of cells), (2) candidate enhancer-gene pairs (a signal peak with a gene arrow), (3) model prediction (a highlighted model box) — connected by arrows. Output an SVG plus PDF/PNG at about 120 x 45 mm, named pipeline_schematic.
assertions: Containers use #DEDFE1 without a border and the model box is #9C4787
The gene arrow is #54AB58 and arrowheads are filled polygons (the notched shape), not marker triangles
At most three distinct stroke widths are used, from the 0.25 / 0.9 / 1.85 pt family
Stage headings are numbered '(1)', '(2)', '(3)' at about 6.5 pt in Helvetica/Arial
The cartoon embedding (cell dots) sits on white, not inside a grey container
The PNG is at least 800 dpi
Connector heads end on the container edge (no intrusion > 1 pt) and are drawn above the containers
